snippet.title: Phantom Streets Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Located in the west of the city, Hialeon is one of Vesper City's most bustling districts. With its dense residential areas, local businesses, industrial zones, and underground connections, Hialeon holds a significant place in the city's criminal underworld.
While ordinary city life prevails during the day, street races, illicit dealings, and criminal organizations reveal Hialeon's true face at night.
